Creates one vacant unit with no tenant. Send a `name`, place it with `location_id` or `external_location_code` (optional when your key reaches a single location), and add your own `external_unit_id` if you have one. Answers `201` with the unit in the same shape `GET /units` returns. Keep its `unit_id` for later calls: `PUT /units/{unit_id}/tenancy` only updates a unit that already exists, so create the unit here first. If the `external_unit_id` already belongs to another unit, it can answer `409` with `code` `external_unit_id_conflict` and create nothing; look that unit up with `GET /units` instead. Needs the `units:write` scope (or its `pms:write` alias) and an `Idempotency-Key` header. To load or reconcile many units at once, use `PATCH /units`.
